THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: KDS/PAN/04/04/02/37.Ministry of Lands & Land Development
I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquirethe following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Lot Nos. 01 - 08 (Lots 08) allotments of land in Total Extentof about 0.1641 Hectare in Preliminari Plan No. Maha 6900prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village ofKosgama in the Grama Niladhari Division of Kosgama (739)in the Minor Divison of Palispattu Korale (West) in theDivisional Secretary's Division of Panwila in Kandy Districtin the Central Province.

01. Lot No. 01Name of Land: Sapumaleewatta; Description: Open WasteLand; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: P. A. M. N.Ranathunga, Sapumaliwatta, Huluganga (A part of Lot No.A110 in P.P. 1334) (A part of T.P 82459); Extent: 0.0088 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02Name of Land: Sapumaleewatta; Description: Open WasteLand; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: S. A. Pushparani,No. 104/1, Huluganga, Madulkale (A part of Lot No. A110 inP.P. 1334) (A part of T.P 82459); Extent: 0.0076 Hectare.

Name of Land: Sapumaleewatta; Description: Open WasteLand; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: S. A. Pushparani,No. 104/1, Huluganga, Madulkale (A part of Lot No. A110 inP.P. 1334) (A part of T.P 82459); Extent: 0.0019 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are herebyrequired to appear personally or by agent duly authorized inwriting, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Panwila on the27.01.2020 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify tome in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 17.01.2020 thenature of their interests in the land, the particulars of theirclaims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands,the amount of compensation and the details of thecomputation of such amount.
NIRANJAN SRIMANTHA SENADHEERA,
Divisional Secretary,
Panwila.
